verdict.rationale: Isaac docs describe simulation, synthetic data, ROS 2 integration, and Python packages, but nothing addresses AI agent authentication with scoped credentials or an API/SDK contract for an agent to command a real robot end-to-end. Probe results show no OpenAPI/API discovery artifacts either. missing for 10: scoped-credential authentication mechanism, agent-facing command API/SDK for real (non-simulated) robots, any security/authorization model for agent access.
